description: One Corte costituzionale decision with its full text (open data, CC BY-SA 3.0, attribution required): testata (presidente, relatore, redattore, dates, collegio) and the sections epigrafe, fatto, diritto, testo, dispositivo, plus the source link. Parameters: ecli (ECLI:IT:COST:<year>:<number>, e.g. ECLI:IT:COST:2017:180). An unknown ecli gives no rows. Example: {"ecli": "ECLI:IT:COST:2017:180"}.
